FINANCE COMMITTEE
                                        MINUTES

A meeting of the Finance Committee was held on Tuesday, April 21, 2026, in City Council
Chambers and via electronic meeting, starting at 12:00 p.m. Those in attendance were as follows:

COMMITTEE MEMBERS: Ken Esquibel. Chairman; Mark Moody; Jeff White (via Zoom),
and Lawrence Wolfe.



                                     AGENDA ITEMS

15.    ORDINANCE       —   3 READING     —   Appropriating money for the Reed Avenue Corridor
       Project.

Mr. Wolfe moved to approve on 3d1 and final reading, seconded by Mr. White. Motion carried
with Mr. White and Mr. Wolfe voting “YES” and Mr. Moody voting “NO.”

Public comment was made by Sophia Maes, Downtown Development Authority Executive
Director.

23.    RESOLUTION Approving a proposition to impose the 1% Specific Purpose Sales and
       Use Tax in Laramie County, State of Wyoming, for the exclusive purpose of funding
       specific purposes for specific amounts; the propositions to be voted on at the election to be
       held on August 18, 2026. (SPONSOR MR. ESQUIBEL)
                                               —




Mr. Wolfe moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. White. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Amber Ash, Mayor’s Chief of Staff, provided a staff report. Committee members Moody and
Wolfe commented on the item.

26.     RESOLUTION      Approving an increase of the budget of the Cheyenne Downtown
                           —




        Development Authority for the Fiscal Year beginning July 1, 2025, and ending June 30,
        2026. (SPONSOR MR. WHITE)
                               —




Mr. Wolfe moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. White. Motion carried with Mr. White and Mr. Wolfe
voting “YES” and Mr. Moody voting “NO.”

Sophia Maes, Downtown Development Authority Executive Director, provided a staff report and
reviewed the areas of increased operating costs. Committee members Moody, Wolfe and White
commented on the item. During public comment “point of order” was raised by Chairman
Esquibel and each member of the committee during comments made by Charles Miller that were
not germane to the topic of the DDA budget.
